description: Rh-AstroX is an innovative digital screening and health monitoring software tool designed for long-duration space missions. The platform analyzes complex blood profiles and genetic biomarkers, focusing specifically on astronauts with Rh-negative blood groups. By processing these unique biological variations, Rh-AstroX predicts the risk levels and progression of neurodegeneration, neurological shifts, and psychological impacts caused by prolonged deep-space exposure.
